title: Unit – 1 : Session – 1 | Introduction to Value Education
sections: Q1. For an animal, physical facility is necessary AND largely adequate — a well-fed, sheltered animal is settled. For a human being, physical facility is necessary but NOT adequate: even with abundant wealth, food and comfort, a person still wants respect, trust, love and clarity of understanding. Animals live by physical facility alone; humans additionally need RELATIONSHIP (with other human beings) and RIGHT UNDERSTANDING (in the Self). This 'something more' is the fundamental difference: without it a human feels empty, anxious and deprived despite material abundance.

Q2. Holistic Development is the transformation from animal consciousness (living only for physical facility) to human consciousness (living with right understanding, relationship AND physical facility, in the right priority). The role of education-sanskar is to enable this transformation: education must develop not just skills for earning, but the RIGHT UNDERSTANDING of what is valuable, the competence to live in RELATIONSHIP, and the wisdom for right utilisation of physical facility. Present education focuses mostly on skills/physical facility and neglects understanding and relationship — hence it produces skilled but unhappy, exploitative people.

Q3. Animal consciousness = living with the assumption 'physical facility is everything'; the person accumulates without limit, exploits others and nature, and remains in contradiction and unhappiness. Human consciousness = living with the correct priority: (1) RIGHT UNDERSTANDING in the Self, (2) RELATIONSHIP (fulfilment of feelings with human beings), (3) PHYSICAL FACILITY (with rest of nature) — physical facility is used, with right understanding, to nurture relationship, not to replace it. The place of each: understanding guides, relationship fulfils, facility serves.
